critical_code_review_comments: report_pdf.py band-merge logic (lines 71-89) treats consecutive columns with the SAME band label AND color as a single segment. This matches the on-screen bandSegs logic in ReportTable.tsx (267-289). Verified with the banded pytest payload — all three segments (Employee, Attendance, Earnings) span the correct column ranges in the generated PDF.

report_pdf.py picks A4 → legal → A3 → A2 landscape based on 0.75× on-screen width fit; a further post-scale renormalises columns to exactly fill page width. Column min clamp of 28 pt is safe for the current screens (>=20 columns still readable at font=6).

report_export.py uses require_role(['super_admin','sub_admin','company_admin']) — 401/403 for unauth and other roles work. _MAX_ROWS=20000 & _MAX_COLS=80 caps are consistent between frontend (rows.slice(0,20000)) and backend.
